 Published Nov. 18, 2026 4:43 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press CSU Fullerton Titans (2-1) at UCLA Bruins (4-0)
 Los Angeles; Wednesday, 10:30 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: CSU Fullerton plays No. 7 UCLA after Joshua Ward scored 21 points in CSU Fullerton's 101-71 win against the Lincoln (CA) Oaklanders.
 UCLA went 17-1 at home a season ago while going 24-12 overall. The Bruins averaged 6.7 steals, 3.0 blocks and 8.3 turnovers per game last season.
 CSU Fullerton went 18-16 overall last season while going 6-10 on the road. The Titans averaged 83.0 points per game while shooting 45.1% from the field and 34.3% from 3-point distance last season.
